name: Futures Rewritten (Ultimate)
about: The sheet NAUR says NA PF tanks use; party mits are mix and match.
Slashes in the sheet mean "and": each one is a separate button.

phases.name: P1 · Fatebreaker
notes: *Shake/Veil can be used prepull to cover break 1
Using too many single target mits on MT for PM2 can cause buff cap, please be careful

phases.name: P2 · Shiva
notes: *Feint/Addle at start of Mirror Image castbar to have back up for Banish III
**Expedience should be used as soon as Frigid Stone prey markers appear, Samba/Tact/Troub should be used walking in before KB

phases.name: P2 · Light Rampant
notes: *Soil/Kera should be used immediately after walking towards the middle tower soak

phases.name: P3 · Gaia
notes: *15s mits slightly after Hell's Judgement to have up for Shell Crusher or additional use on CD for soil/kera
**The timing for 15s to catch Shockwave Pulsar and Memory's End is fairly precise, hit mits at the P in Pulsar

phases.name: P4 · Light and Dark
notes: **Bell and Macro should be used immediately for the Crystallize Time castbar finishes to heal for dark party stack
***Kera/Soil immediately after rewinds are placed to have up for Morn Afah

phases.name: P5 · Pandora
notes: **15s mits on the B in Box, it's more important to catch Fulgent Blade
